credentials.notes: Owned by the kent Vikunja user (all-permissions API token). Originally added by #715 as a config/system token because Vikunja scopes labels/filters per user (taxonomy labels created by felix-bot are invisible in kent's UI and felix-bot cannot attach kent-owned labels — HTTP 403). ADR-0007 (#860 phase 2) promoted it to the SOLE RUNTIME Vikunja credential: every runtime Felix→Vikunja consumer now resolves this token through scripts/common/vikunja_config.get_vikunja_token_path() (directly or via the shared VikunjaClient default). The felix-bot audit distinction at the Vikunja API layer is deliberately dropped (see ADR-0007) — the correctness gain (kent sees projects 16-20 + Inbox 1, closing #860) and the removal of the 403 failure surface (closing #750) outweigh it. Runtime and the #748 validator now share the kent view so they cannot silently diverge (FR-005). felix-bot's task-write path (vikunja-api) is retired to dormant. See identity-model.md §Agent Service Accounts and docs/design/architecture/adr/0007-retire-vikunja-felix-bot.md.
credentials.expiry_notes: Vikunja UI requires an explicit expiry; operator set 2027-07-12 (1-year, created 2026-07-12 10:58:07). credential-health-check.service should alert ~30 days before (~2027-06-12). Now the SOLE runtime Vikunja credential (ADR-0007) — rotate before expiry to maintain ALL Felix Vikunja capability, not just config.

rules: No credentials in committed files — ever
Interactive auth for manual scripts (setup_vikunja.py pattern)
Stored tokens for agent/automated use in office2 scoped secrets store
Credential names are stable identifiers used across documentation and code

No Anthropic API credentials on any development machine - named explicitly: the MacBook Pro and office4 (ruled 2026-08-29, #912/#882; 'the laptop' was ambiguous once office4 existed and would have let it slip through). Live tests and spikes run on office2, or source a key ad-hoc for the run. A globally exported key buys nothing (the one live-test consumer, tests/inbox/test_classifier_regression.py, is gated on CLASSIFIER_REGRESSION_LIVE=1 as well as the key) and it prompts every Claude Code session. See #882.

No plaintext credential files on office4 - specifically spec-kitty-saas/.env, which holds ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, OPENAI_API_KEY, STRIPE_LIVE_SECRET_KEY, GITHUB_APP_PRIVATE_KEY and CONNECTOR_ENCRYPTION_KEYS (ruled 2026-08-29, #912). It is gitignored so nothing is committed, but it is plaintext on disk and the migration would have duplicated it onto a second machine. When spec-kitty-saas migrates under #914, its secrets come from 1Password at run time rather than a checked-out .env. Note this rule is already violated on the MacBook Pro - that is pre-existing and tracked separately, not licence to repeat it here.
Record the console workspace for any credential whose provider scopes keys by workspace - a credential that cannot be located in the console cannot be revoked under pressure. See #883.
